heading: Duty to maintain corporate and tax-exempt status

tree.heading: Corporate Status.—
tree.text: The corporation shall maintain its status as a corporation incorporated under the laws of New York.

tree.heading: Tax-Exempt Status.—
tree.text: The corporation shall maintain its status as an organization exempt from taxation under the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 (26 U.S.C. 1 et seq.).
